items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Key CVEs include CVE-2026-47984 and CVE-2026-47996.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a full-page cache extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. All Mirasvit Cache Warmer versions before 1.11.12 are vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) allowing arbitrary file system write.

items.id: PolyShell (no CVE provided by source, fixed in APSB26-49)
items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store, bypassing validation using a polyglot. Attacks have been observed on a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including Incorrect Authorization (CVE-2026-21284), Improper Access Control (CVE-2026-21285), and Stored XSS (CVE-2026-21310), which could lead to full system takeover, data leaks, and admin hijacking.
